coordinate_format.origin_definition: origin_mm is the physical DICOM-LPS coordinate in mm of the CENTER of saved voxel [0,0,0].
coordinate_format.final_volume_reference: The origin_mm value in meta.json refers to the CENTER of saved voxel [0,0,0] of the final volume (volume_hu_cropped.npy and aligned masks).
coordinate_format.origin_mm_definition: origin_mm is the physical DICOM-LPS coordinate [LPS x, LPS y, LPS z] of the CENTER of saved CT voxel [0,0,0] in volume_hu_cropped.npy.

coordinate_vector_semantics.physical_vector: [LPS x, LPS y, LPS z] in millimetres
coordinate_vector_semantics.direction_matrix: Columns of direction_lps give the physical LPS direction of the array Z, Y, X axes respectively. The matrix must be orthonormal; either determinant sign is valid because array-axis and physical-coordinate ordering differ.

coordinate_format.ct_origin_reference: This is the cropped Stage 01 CT frame. A Z-crop changes origin_mm while preserving voxel spacing and direction_lps; no resampling is performed by Stage 01.
coordinate_format.anatomical_coordinate_note: Anatomical localization is attached to detector candidates and patches; it does not change the voxel or DICOM-LPS coordinate frame.

outputs.volume_hu.npy: float32, complete HU volume before Z-cropping
outputs.volume_hu_cropped.npy: float32, final Z-cropped HU result volume
outputs.volume_hu_masked.npy: float32, final Z-cropped volume with voxels outside lung_mask blanked to the configured physical-air HU
outputs.volume_windowed.npy: uint8, final Z-cropped 3-channel volume [lung window, soft-tissue window, bone window]
outputs.heart_mask.npy: bool, ZYX conservative central cardiac/mediastinal exclusion mask, aligned to volume_hu_cropped.npy and constrained to voxels outside lung_mask
outputs.meta.json: per-patient metadata conforming to this coordinate convention
outputs.anatomical_location: Heuristic anatomical localization attached to each detector candidate and extracted patch; not a new segmentation mask.
outputs.03_nodule_classification: Stage 03 per-patch nodule attribute predictions, attention weights, and provenance.
outputs.heart_tracking_diagnostics.json: JSON report describing expanding 3D central-rod heart/mediastinal tracking, selected radius, Z span and failure reason.
outputs.heart_mask_review_attestation.json: Optional JSON operator attestation after visual review of the new Stage 01 central-rod mask QC montage; not an automated clinical validation.
outputs.volume_hu_heart_excluded.npy: float32, final Z-cropped HU volume with heart/central-mediastinal exclusion-mask voxels replaced by configured physical-air HU; same ZYX geometry as volume_hu_cropped.npy

imaging_clinical_contract.count_policy: Study-level counts are derived from persisted Stage 02 raw/fused/rejected records and Stage 04 prediction records. Missing artifacts produce null counts or explicit errors, never zero risk or successful stage states.
imaging_clinical_contract.eligible_nodule_policy: Only Stage 02 lung-mask-gated candidates joined through Stage 03/04/06 are emitted as nodule records.

not_direct_observations: SMOKING_PREDICTIONS_3_CLASSES is excluded as an observed smoking history predictor

imaging_clinical_contract.unknown_value_semantics: Unknown, not_reported, reported-present, and reported-absent values are represented separately; absent properties are not interpreted as negative findings.

input_volume.description: Final Z-cropped, unmasked HU volume used for detection and patch extraction.

authoritative_detector.name: ViTDet3D

normalization.note: These normalization constants are specific to the pretrained ViTDet3D detector.

authoritative_detector.candidate_center_authority: ViTDet3D retains its own post-NMS proposal geometry; after cross-detector deduplication matched centers and boxes are combined with equal weights. Single-detector candidates retain their own geometry.

candidate_physical_coordinate.definition: DICOM-LPS [x,y,z] millimetre coordinate of center_zyx mapped through origin_mm, spacing_zyx_mm, and direction_lps.

diagnostic_log_detector.note: LoG and ViTDet3D are peer candidate sources. Raw detections are fused before one shared anatomical gate; one-detector candidates remain eligible.
diagnostic_log_detector.stage03_inference_note: Selected LoG proposals are represented in the fused primary patch manifest and pass through the same Stage 03 and Stage 04 gates as ViTDet3D candidates. An optional separate LoG manifest is audit-only.
diagnostic_log_detector.patch_limit_description: Legacy separate-LoG limit retained for CLI compatibility; the only downstream limit is the schema-defined top 50 after fusion and lung/heart eligibility.

patch_coordinate_conventions.patch_origin_definition: patch_origin_lps_mm is the physical DICOM-LPS [x,y,z] coordinate of the CENTER of saved patch voxel [0,0,0]. It is computed from the source CT origin and crop_start_zyx, so it remains valid even when the requested crop extends outside the native CT and is filled with virtual air padding.
patch_coordinate_conventions.patch_spacing_definition: patch_spacing_zyx_mm equals the source CT spacing_zyx_mm because patches are cropped without resampling.
patch_coordinate_conventions.patch_center_definition: patch_center_local_zyx is the nearest integer voxel location of the authoritative detector center inside the saved patch.

crop_bounds.out_of_volume_behavior: Virtual air padding using the HU value resolved through patch_padding_hu_ref.

patch_coordinate_conventions.bbox_local_mapping: bbox_local_start_zyx = bbox_start_zyx - crop_start_zyx and bbox_local_end_zyx = bbox_end_zyx - crop_start_zyx, clipped to the saved patch bounds for visualization/statistics.

patch_record_fields.patch_id: Sequential patch identifier assigned during extraction.
patch_record_fields.candidate_id: Stable identity of an accepted fused detector candidate.
patch_record_fields.center_zyx: Equal-weight fused detector center, or the sole source center, in source CT voxel coordinates.
patch_record_fields.center_lps_mm: Same center expressed in DICOM-LPS millimetres.
patch_record_fields.source_clip_start_zyx: Portion of crop intersecting the source CT.
patch_record_fields.source_clip_end_zyx: Portion of crop intersecting the source CT, exclusive.
patch_record_fields.patch_center_local_zyx: Nearest integer voxel to the detector center within patch coordinates.
patch_record_fields.patch_size_vox_zyx: Saved patch shape in ZYX voxels.
patch_record_fields.spacing_zyx_mm: Native CT spacing inherited by the patch.
patch_record_fields.direction_lps: Same axis-direction matrix as the source CT.
patch_record_fields.bbox_start_zyx: Detector bounding-box start in source CT ZYX voxel coordinates.
patch_record_fields.bbox_end_zyx: Detector bounding-box end in source CT ZYX voxel coordinates.
patch_record_fields.bbox_local_start_zyx: Detector bounding-box start in patch-local ZYX coordinates.
patch_record_fields.bbox_local_end_zyx: Detector bounding-box end in patch-local ZYX coordinates.
patch_record_fields.bbox_size_vox_zyx: Bounding-box extent along source CT Z/Y/X axes.
patch_record_fields.bbox_size_mm_zyx: Bounding-box physical extent along source CT Z/Y/X axes, in millimetres.
patch_record_fields.padding_value_hu: HU used for out-of-volume patch padding, sourced through patch_padding_hu_ref.
patch_record_fields.intensity_statistics: HU statistics for detector-bbox voxels and surrounding native CT context.
patch_record_fields.anatomical_location: Heuristic anatomical localization object copied from the authoritative candidate; uses the same detector center and CT geometry.
patch_record_fields.detection_source: Proposal source, either ViTDet3D, LoG, or Merged; both sources are eligible for downstream inference.
patch_record_fields.diagnostic_id: Original LoG detector identifier when a LoG source record is present.
patch_record_fields.log_response: Raw LoG detector response; not calibrated as a probability.
patch_record_fields.scale_mm: LoG Gaussian scale/diameter metadata in millimetres.

outputs.candidates.json: Authoritative validated, deduplicated LoG + ViTDet3D candidate union.
outputs.vitdet_raw_detections.json: Persisted raw ViTDet3D detections before NMS, fusion, and mask gating for study-level audit counts.
outputs.detector_metadata.json: Detector, CT-frame, patch-frame, and provenance metadata.
outputs.candidate_filter_report.json: Counts and rejection reasons for the pre-patch lung/heart acceptance gate.
outputs.candidates_rejected_audit.json: Fused candidates outside the validated lung/heart mask and eligible candidates beyond top-50; audit only, never downstream input.
outputs.log_candidates_diagnostic.json: Raw LoG source records retained as audit evidence; accepted fused candidates are in candidates.json.
outputs.log_candidate_filter_report.json: Counts of LoG evidence represented by fused candidates that passed or failed the shared mask gate.
outputs.log_candidates_rejected_audit.json: Rejected fused candidates with LoG evidence; audit only, never downstream input.
outputs.patches/patches_manifest.json: Per-patch geometry, coordinates, provenance, and characterization.
outputs.log_diagnostic_patches/log_patches_manif: Optional audit patch records for LoG source proposals; authoritative selected candidates use the primary patch manifest.
Float32 ZYX patch for a LoG diagnostic proposal (patch IDs are local to the diagnostic manifest).

anatomical_localization.purpose: Describe where a ViTDet3D detector proposal lies within the existing Stage 01 lung/air/heart masks.

coordinate_rules.laterality_rule: DICOM-LPS +X is patient left. Candidate LPS X above the lung centroid X is labeled left; below is right; within the configured tolerance is midline/central.

anatomical_location_fields.laterality: left, right, midline, midline_or_central, or unknown.
anatomical_location_fields.compartment: airway, lung_wall, parenchyma, mediastinum, or outside_lung.
anatomical_location_fields.vertical_region: superior, middle, inferior, or unknown based on axial lung extent.
anatomical_location_fields.wall_relationship: Relationship to the Stage 01 lung-mask boundary.
anatomical_location_fields.distance_to_lung_mask_mm: Local physical distance to the lung-mask boundary.
anatomical_location_fields.airway_proximity_mm: Local physical distance to the retained central airway proxy.
anatomical_location_fields.center_inside_lung_mask: Whether the rounded detector center lies in lung_mask.npy.
anatomical_location_fields.center_inside_heart_mask: Whether the rounded detector center lies in heart_mask.npy.
anatomical_location_fields.center_lps_mm: DICOM-LPS physical coordinate of the detector center.
anatomical_location_fields.limitations: Explicit statement that this is heuristic rather than clinical anatomical segmentation.

output_locations.candidates.json: Each accepted fused LoG/ViTDet3D candidate contains anatomical_location.
output_locations.candidates.csv: Flat anatomical location columns mirror anatomical_location.primary, region, laterality, and compartment.
output_locations.patches/patches_manifest.json: Each extracted patch record contains the same anatomical_location object copied from its authoritative candidate.
output_locations.detector_metadata.json: Contains the anatomical-localization configuration used for the run.

anatomical_localization.limitations: No dedicated anatomical atlas or airway segmentation model is used. Trachea/bronchus labels are inferred from the Stage 01 physical-air mask and central 3-D connectivity; lung-wall labels use local distance to the Stage 01 lung-mask boundary. These labels are for pipeline localization/QA and should not be treated as clinical anatomy.

candidate_acceptance_filter.center_rule: After spatial fusion, validate ZYX/LPS geometry and round center_zyx to nearest voxel; accept only if lung_mask is true and heart_mask is false. Invalid masks or transforms block all downstream processing.
candidate_acceptance_filter.diagnostic_source_policy: LoG and ViTDet3D have equal standing; fuse/deduplicate their complete raw candidate union before applying one mask gate. Candidates found by either detector alone remain eligible. The separate LoG manifest is empty and audit-only.

candidate_fusion.spatial_match_rule: Merge when physical center distance <= 3 mm; otherwise merge only when distance <= 8 mm and 3-D box IoU >= 0.25.
candidate_fusion.geometry_conflict_rule: Average within-detector center/box geometry, then average the detector-level geometries with equal-weight detector contributions; no source is authoritative.
candidate_fusion.score_rule: Keep native detector scores separate. Rank candidates within each detector and use the mean of available [0,1] detector rank percentiles for top-50 selection.
candidate_fusion.stable_identity_rule: Derive stable_nodule_id from patient, study, series, and fused physical LPS center using a source-neutral canonical identity namespace.

diagnostic_patch_outputs.note: Legacy manifest remains empty because LoG proposals are fused into the authoritative candidate stream; no second Stage 03 inference stream is created.

inputs.log_diagnostic_policy: The legacy separate LoG manifest is intentionally empty. LoG proposals enter Stages 03–06 only after fusion, shared lung-mask gating, and top-50 selection in the primary Stage 02 manifest.

prediction_semantics.expected_rating: Expected rating on the LIDC-style 1-to-5 ordinal scale; not a calibrated probability.
prediction_semantics.attribute_provenance: Stage 03 values are frozen-model predictions, not current-patient measured features or annotation-derived reader labels. Model output distributions may describe ordinal uncertainty but are not calibrated confidence.
prediction_semantics.diagnosis_and_pathology: Not inferred by Stages 03–06; unavailable unless provided by a separate validated source.

coordinate_conventions.patch_origin_definition: patch_origin_lps_mm is the physical DICOM-LPS [x,y,z] coordinate of the CENTER of saved patch voxel [0,0,0]. It is computed from the source CT origin and crop_start_zyx, so it remains valid even when the requested crop extends outside the native CT and is filled with virtual air padding.

prediction_record_fields.center_zyx: Authoritative Stage 02 detector center in source CT coordinates.
prediction_record_fields.patch_origin_lps_mm: Physical center coordinate of patch voxel [0,0,0].
prediction_record_fields.attributes: Six frozen-model expected ordinal rating predictions, with source, scale, output distribution, and model-derived dispersion/entropy. They are not measured current-patient findings or annotation-derived reader labels; confidence is not calibrated.
prediction_record_fields.annotation_labels: Unavailable unless supplied by a separate annotation-ingestion step; not generated from Stage 03 predictions.
prediction_record_fields.measured_features: Unavailable; Stage 03 predicts reader-style attributes and does not measure them from patient metadata.
prediction_record_fields.patch_array_path: Source patch array used for inference.
prediction_record_fields.detection_source: Source lineage for an authoritative spatially fused LoG/ViTDet3D candidate.
prediction_record_fields.diagnostic_id: Legacy detector-specific LoG identifier retained only in provenance.

limitations: Expected ratings are not calibrated class probabilities.
Stage 03 emits six attributes only: subtlety, sphericity, margin, lobulation, spiculation and texture.
Internal structure and calcification are unsupported by the supplied frozen hybrid checkpoints.
Malignancy is not a Stage 03 output.
Inference requires checkpoints compatible with the current spatial-hybrid model and preprocessing.
LoG and ViTDet3D candidates enter Stage 03 only through the accepted fused Stage 02 manifest. The legacy separate LoG manifest remains empty to prevent duplicate inference.

preprocessing.pixel_to_hu_formula: HU = stored_pixel_value * RescaleSlope + RescaleIntercept; map PixelPaddingValue..PixelPaddingRangeLimit and HU below out_of_scan_pixel_hu_floor to air_replacement_hu.
preprocessing.windowing_formula: clip(HU, center - width/2, center + width/2); map clipped range linearly to uint8 [0,255].

heart_tracking.description: HU-guided expanding central Z-rod: only voxels in the configured soft-tissue HU interval can seed or grow the mask; slices with insufficient thoracic lung area are excluded so inferior liver/upper-abdominal tissue cannot seed tracking; the tracked mask may overlap the provisional lung mask and Stage 01 subtracts it after tracking. Shape growth is bounded by physical contour motion and an adjacent-slice area ratio. Heuristic central cardiac/mediastinal exclusion requiring visual QC, not clinical heart segmentation.
heart_tracking.compatibility_note: heart_mask.npy is a bool ZYX heuristic cardiac/mediastinal exclusion mask. Its HU range and thoracic-slice gate constrain actual growth, and it can overlap provisional lung_mask until Stage 01 applies lung_mask &= ~heart_mask. volume_hu_heart_excluded.npy is aligned float32 HU and is not the default Stage 02 detector input. Visual QC remains mandatory.

validated_automated_requires: aligned CT, masks, window volumes, and crop geometry
mask_quality.review_policy: Mask quality is automatically validated. Visual review and hash-bound operator attestation are optional and are not a Stage 02 gate.

review_qc.attestation_policy: Review montages and hash-bound operator attestations may be generated for optional research QA, but are not required for pipeline execution.

stage_04_malignancy_prediction.semantics: Brock/PanCan research malignancy-risk estimate; not a cancer probability, histological classification, or diagnosis.
stage_04_malignancy_prediction.explanation_semantics: Analytical Brock formula contributions on the logit scale; not SHAP, causal effects, or percentage-point probability changes.
stage_04_malignancy_prediction.input_validation: Reject unknown predictor fields and unselected stable nodule IDs. Missing required values produce incomplete status; detector size and Stage 03 attribute predictions are never mapped into Brock predictors.
stage_04_malignancy_prediction.diagnosis_and_pathology: Separate fields explicitly remain not_predicted/not_provided; Brock output is not confirmed diagnosis, pathology, or histological subtype.

stage_05_gradcam.target_scalar_definition: SpatialObjectiveModel.expected_ratings(outputs)[0, MODEL_TARGET_INDEX[attribute]]; expected LIDC attribute rating on the schema-declared scale.
stage_05_gradcam.raw_cam_formula: sum_channel(mean_spatial_gradient(d target expected_rating / d target_layer_activation) * target_layer_activation); trilinear interpolation to the input patch; signed values preserved without ReLU.
stage_05_gradcam.gradient_polarity_semantics: Positive raw values indicate positive gradient-weighted activation with respect to increasing the selected expected-rating scalar; this is a model sensitivity signal, not a causal or voxelwise attribute probability. No attribute-specific inversion is applied.

stage_06_full_ct_gradcam.mapping_rule: patch voxel [z,y,x] maps to CT voxel [z,y,x] = crop_start_zyx + patch voxel index; invalid/out-of-volume portions are clipped.
stage_06_full_ct_gradcam.overlap_rule: mean of available per-patch Rainbow-scaled CAM values
stage_06_full_ct_gradcam.unqualified_cam_policy: Only patch_id == 0 may use filenames without a patch identifier.

metadata_policy.schema_version_semantics: Metadata contract version only; does not identify or mutate trained checkpoint versions.
metadata_policy.legacy_behavior: If a Stage 01/02 artifact lacks meta_schema_version, scripts may accept it with an explicit warning; if present and mismatched, fail fast. Stage 07 report outputs are tagged with the schema version and excluded-outside-lung candidates are kept in a separate audit CSV.

stage_07_visualize.center_in_mask_rule: Round center_zyx to nearest voxel and sample the Stage 01 lung_mask.npy at that voxel; out-of-volume or false mask samples are excluded from the visible candidate list and accepted CSV.
stage_07_visualize.anatomical_location_source: Stage 02 anatomical_location heuristic; when unavailable, derive wall-versus-parenchyma from lung-mask distance transform and report airway category as unclassified.
clinical_limitations: Candidate counts are spatially deduplicated detector proposals whose rounded centers lie in lung_mask.npy, not adjudicated unique nodules.
Stage 04 Brock outputs are research/POC malignancy-risk estimates, not cancer probabilities, histological classifications, or diagnoses.
Bronchus/trachea/wall/parenchyma labels are heuristic, not a dedicated anatomical segmentation or clinical ground truth.
